mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries to have non-Read access types (e.g., Write, Delete). This directly violates the append-only invariant and v1's read-only scope. The assertions should fail when this structural constraint is removed.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.access_type != Read }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact permits authorized access without requiring care-team membership. The model can then have Permitted outcomes where no active CareTeamMembership exists, violating the core authorization rule.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipViolation { some ae: AuditEntry, p: Patient | ae.outcome = Permitted and ae.patient_id_from_request = p.patient_id and no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.patient = p and ctm.status = Active }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact decouples outcome types from their authorisation basis. The model can then have Denied outcomes with PatientNotFound basis or vice versa, which leaks information about whether a patient exists.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InformationLeakage { some ae: AuditEntry | (ae.outcome = Denied and ae.authorisation_basis = PatientNotFound) or (ae.outcome = NotFoundOrDenied and ae.authorisation_basis = NotCareTeamMember) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact permits audit entries with recorded clinician fields that don't match any real clinician in the system. This violates the integrity of the audit trail and allows misattribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | no c: Clinician | c.clinician_id = ae.recorded_clinician_id and c.display_name = ae.recorded_clinician_display_name and c.clinician_role = ae.recorded_clinician_role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the model to have an empty universe with no clinicians, patients, or audit entries. This makes quantified assertions vacuously true (e.g., 'all ae: AuditEntry | ...' is trivially true when no audit entries exist), masking the actual invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonEmptyForce { some Clinician and some Patient and some AuditEntry }

mutation_targets.rationale: This is the most direct structural constraint on immutability. Removing it is the primary way to test that the AppendOnly assertion genuinely constrains the model.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AllowWriteOps { all ae: AuditEntry | ae.access_type in (Read) }
